correctness.rationale: The actual proof correctly reduces all Euclidean pullbacks to diagonal forms by coordinate-sign averaging. For q_t=x^2+t y^2 it derives F_t(s)=sqrt(16+(1+s)^4)/(4(1+t s^2)). At t0=1/sqrt(17) the two endpoint values agree, the exact polynomial difference shows all interior values are larger, and the derivative has the sign of h(s)=(1+s)^3(sqrt(17)-s)-16s. The phi-analysis proves exactly one positive critical root s_*. Comparing F_t(s_*) against the appropriate endpoint proves every t != t0 has larger distortion. The inspected verifier independently brackets s_* in (3.511,3.512), confirms the negative discriminant and high-precision stated D_*; these numerical checks corroborate rather than replace the analytic minimax proof.
